action.help: Accepted findings reopen automatically after the expiry date. False positives stay closed permanently.
action.title: Decide
agents.name: name
agents.only_hub: Agents are only used in the hub role.
channels.test_help: Save first. The test is sent by the scan service, which can read root-only secret files.
channels.test_queued: Queued – the scan service sends it…
collector.auth.desc: Counts logins/failures from journald and reports anomalies.
collector.auth.title: Auth monitoring
collector.containers.desc: Scans the images of running docker/podman containers.
collector.containers.privacy: Images are read from the local engine, never pulled. Uses the same Trivy DB download.
collector.containers.title: Container images (Trivy)
collector.exposure.desc: Listening sockets vs. expected ports, TLS and security headers of your own public names.
collector.exposure.privacy: Connects only to your own names/IP; resolves them via public DNS.
collector.exposure.title: Exposure
collector.lynis.desc: Lynis audit: hardening index, warnings and suggestions.
collector.lynis.privacy: Runs locally, nothing is downloaded or sent.
collector.lynis.title: Hardening (Lynis)
collector.nix.desc: Checks the current (and booted) system closure against NVD.
collector.nix.privacy: Downloads NVD CVE feeds from nvd.nist.gov. Nothing is sent.
collector.nix.title: NixOS packages (vulnix)
collector.os.desc: Scans Debian/Ubuntu/Alpine/RHEL… packages of the host file system.
collector.os.privacy: Downloads the Trivy vulnerability DB (mirror.gcr.io / ghcr.io). Version check and telemetry are switched off.
collector.os.title: OS packages (Trivy rootfs)
collector.sbom.title: SBOM
collector.secrets.desc: Finds committed secrets in configured repositories.
collector.secrets.privacy: Runs locally; optional git URLs are cloned read-only into the cache.
collector.secrets.title: Secrets (gitleaks)
collector.updates.desc: Channel head vs. locked nixpkgs, newer image tags, tool/DB freshness.
collector.updates.privacy: Asks api.github.com / registries for public metadata only (repository and image names).
collector.updates.title: Updates
detect.containers_hidden: not visible to the web process (rootful) – the scan service lists them
detect.live_only: live check only (run a scan for full results)
enricher.cvss.privacy: Offline: derives severity from the CVSS score.
enricher.cvss.title: CVSS bands
enricher.epss.privacy: Default: downloads the full daily score file, so no CVE list leaves the host. API mode sends the found CVE IDs to api.first.org.
enricher.epss.title: FIRST EPSS
enricher.kev.privacy: Downloads the KEV catalog from cisa.gov once a day. Nothing is sent.
enricher.kev.title: CISA KEV
f.agent.ui: Serve the UI on this agent
f.notify.dedup_hours: Do not repeat a finding for (hours)
f.notify.max_per_hour: Max messages per channel and hour
f.schedule.reports.weekly.notify_only_if: Weekly notification only if items are open
h.admin_password: At least 10 characters, stored as an argon2 hash
h.collectors.nix.whitelist: TOML whitelist files or URLs, one per line
h.notify.ntfy.url: Your own ntfy server, e.g. https://ntfy.example.org
h.registry_file: Optional JSON list of services (url, exposure) – e.g. /etc/homelab/registry.json
h.web.auth_mode: Trusted proxy: only if a reverse proxy restricts access (e.g. LAN/VPN + SSO)
h.web.base_url: Used for the click link in notifications, e.g. https://sec.example.org
lang.name: English
login.setup_hint: Enter the one-time setup code from {path} on the server (e.g. sudo cat /var/lib/secwatch/setup-code). It protects the wizard until an admin password is set.
login.title: Sign in
notify.test_body: If you can read this, notifications work.
ov.no_hosts: No host has been scanned yet. Press “Scan now”.
phase2.body.auth: Login statistics from journald (sshd, fail2ban, apps) with charts per source and day and anomaly detection.
phase2.body.exposure: Expected vs. actually listening ports per host, external reachability of your public names, TLS and HTTP security header checks.
phase2.body.hardening: Lynis hardening index over time, warnings and suggestions per host.
phase2.body.secrets: gitleaks scans of your repositories – file, line and rule, never the secret itself.
phase2.body.updates: Channel freshness of your flake, newer container image tags and tool/database freshness.
phase2.enable: Enable this check (takes effect once implemented)
phase2.note: The check is already registered: switching it on now is harmless and it will start working after the update.
phase2.title: Coming in phase 2
report.no_previous: No previous monthly report to compare with.
reports.compare_need_two: At least two monthly reports are needed.
scan.queued: Scan queued. It starts within a few seconds (systemd path unit / scheduler).
secret.status.unreadable: set (not readable for the web process)
settings.locked: Set by the system configuration (NixOS module / environment) – read-only here.
settings.locked_info: {n} values are set declaratively and shown read-only.
wiz.agents.intro: Hub: agents to pull from (URL + token). Agent: the token the hub must present.
wiz.agents.title: Agents
wiz.auth.intro: Log sources and thresholds for login anomaly detection.
wiz.auth.title: Auth monitoring
wiz.channels.intro: Configure ntfy and/or SMTP mail. Secrets are written to files in the state directory, never into config.yaml.
wiz.channels.title: Channels
wiz.checks.intro: Enable or disable each check. “Automatic” decides from the detected environment. The notes say what is downloaded from where.
wiz.checks.title: Checks
wiz.environment.intro: secwatch detected the following. The scan service (root) sees more than the web process; values are refreshed with every scan.
wiz.environment.title: Environment
wiz.exposure.intro: Your public names/IP and the ports that are expected to be open. Pre-filled from detection and the registry file.
wiz.exposure.title: Exposure
wiz.matrix.intro: Choose per event and severity whether to send a push (ntfy) and/or a mail.
wiz.matrix.title: Notifications
wiz.schedule.intro: When scans run and reports are written. Reports are always generated – notifications are configured separately.
wiz.schedule.title: Schedule
wiz.secrets.intro: Repositories (local paths) and optional git URLs to scan for committed secrets.
wiz.secrets.title: Secrets
wiz.summary.intro: Check the summary. Saving marks setup as complete and queues the first scan.
wiz.summary.title: Summary
wiz.welcome.intro: Choose language and role, and protect the dashboard with an admin password. Settings are stored in config.yaml in the state directory.
wiz.welcome.title: Welcome
wizard.phase2_note: This check arrives in phase 2. You can configure and enable it already.
group.daily.help: Only new findings since the previous daily report.
group.weekly.help: All findings that are still open, grouped by severity and host.
group.monthly.help: Totals, new/fixed during the month and comparison with previous months. Always generated, even if its notification is off.
